production_authenticity.runtime_data_source: The same deterministic SQL seed contract is loaded into PostgreSQL by the environment bootstrap; SQLite is used only by the control-plane validator to inspect the seed artifact.
production_authenticity.synthetic_data_boundary: All records and payload bytes are synthetic; no real host, account, identity, credential, or forensic evidence is included.
